description: This file contains utility functions for streaming and parsing server-sent events (SSE), streaming response bodies as text, and streaming newline-delimited JSON from HTTP responses.

methods.name: parseSseLine
methods.description: Parses a single line from an SSE stream, returning an object indicating if parsing is complete and the data.

methods.name: streamResponse
methods.description: Streams a Response body as UTF-8 text chunks, handling cancellation and errors.

methods.name: streamSse
methods.description: Streams and parses Server-Sent Events from a Response, yielding parsed data objects.

methods.name: streamJSON
methods.description: Streams newline-delimited JSON objects from a Response.
